Soft pieces

Vegetable fritters

Zöldséges lepény

8 months+ Adjusted 25 min 4 portions

Serve soft pieces, never loose corn kernels. Use the rice version when the meal must be free of gluten.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 eggs (cooked through)
  • 80 g cooked bulgur or cooked rice (use rice for a gluten-free fritter)
  • 1 medium carrot (grated)
  • 60 g corn (mashed, not whole kernels)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (thin film in the pan)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Mash the corn so no whole kernels remain.
  2. Mix the eggs with the grated carrot, mashed corn, and cooked bulgur.
  3. Use soft cooked rice instead of bulgur in that step if the fritter must be gluten-free.
  4. Heat a thin film of oil and cook small fritters over moderate heat, then turn them.
  5. Cook until the egg is fully set and the fritter is soft rather than crisp, and add no salt.

Adjusted

Whole corn kernels are a choking hazard, and the usual note already warned them off for younger babies. Salt is also unnecessary in this egg batter.

Mash the corn before it goes into the batter. Pan-fry egg with grated carrot and cooked bulgur, or use cooked rice in that step when you need a gluten-free fritter, and add no salt.
